correctness.rationale: The proof exactly integrates multiplicity-weighted Gaussian mass in all three geometric regimes, including both nonsmooth boundaries. The ratio exp(-2rd/σ²) is strictly decreasing, so the derivatives have the asserted unique switches and yield the four mutually consistent global maximizing cases within the explicitly stated symmetric class. A separate finite direct-integration checker passed 97444 assertions; the proof does not depend on those samples.

value.rationale: The design concerns a natural physically motivated issue: where to locate three spare fallible plume alarms when crosswind center is uncertain. Two distinct coverage-contact geometries produce a nonzero reliability interval of exactly fixed optimal half-spacing and an explicit four-regime map, giving a directly reproducible benchmark. The result is not claimed as universal sensor placement or an instrument-calibrated policy.
